The AFR facility is the first new refinery to be constructed in the United States in more than 50 years. An artist rendering of the America First Refining large-scale refining facility in Brownsville, Texas, the first new refinery to be constructed in the United States in more than 50 years. Fluor will recognize the undisclosed contract value in the first quarter of 2026.
